name: Seed-address referential algebra
formal_definition: Typed BIP39/BIP32/BIP84/Bech32 profile with public-only certificates and an authorization gate.

name: Source and standards boundary
formal_definition: Separate BIP-defined transformations, engineering glue, public fixtures, metrics and rejected attack scopes.

name: Secret/public classification
formal_definition: Entropy, mnemonic, passphrase, seed, private scalar and chain code are secret; addresses, scripts and test vectors are public.

name: 2048-word list commitment
formal_definition: Bind the selected BIP39 wordlist by count, order, uniqueness, normalization and SHA-256 digest.

name: Computer-generated entropy input
formal_definition: Admit only ENT in {128,160,192,224,256}; do not treat arbitrary user sentences as entropy.

name: BIP39 checksum prefix
formal_definition: CS=ENT/32 and checksum bits are the first CS bits of SHA-256(entropy).

name: Entropy-checksum concatenation
formal_definition: Append checksum bits to entropy before word segmentation.

name: Eleven-bit segmentation
formal_definition: Split ENT+CS into ordered 11-bit cells, each in [0,2047].

name: Word-index lookup
formal_definition: Map each 11-bit cell to one word in the committed list.

name: Ordered word-cell complex
formal_definition: Represent the mnemonic as a 1D path of labeled 11-bit cells whose adjacency preserves word order.

name: Mnemonic checksum hinge
formal_definition: A mnemonic is admitted only when observed checksum cells equal the entropy-hash prefix.

name: Unicode NFKD normalization
formal_definition: Normalize mnemonic and passphrase as required before seed derivation.

name: Mnemonic-to-seed transition
formal_definition: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 with 2048 iterations, 64-byte output and salt 'mnemonic'+passphrase.

name: Seed nonserialization
formal_definition: Seed bytes are transient and excluded from substrate definitions, traces, certificates and package data.

name: BIP32 master node
formal_definition: HMAC-SHA512 with key 'Bitcoin seed' creates a private scalar and 32-byte chain code.

name: Extended-key tree node
formal_definition: Node state is key material plus chain code, depth, parent fingerprint and child number.

name: Normal derivation edge
formal_definition: Indices below 2^31 admit private and public child derivation under BIP32 rules.

name: Hardened derivation edge
formal_definition: Indices at or above 2^31 require parent private material and block public-parent derivation.

name: Derivation-path parser
formal_definition: Parse m/... with explicit hardened markers and uint32 bounds.

name: Five-level account hierarchy
formal_definition: Purpose/coin/account/change/index are distinct typed path levels.

name: Native P2WPKH derivation policy
formal_definition: Use m/84'/coin'/account'/change/index for BIP84 accounts.

name: secp256k1 public projection
formal_definition: Map a valid scalar to a curve point without exposing a signing API.

name: Compressed public key
formal_definition: Serialize a curve point as parity prefix plus 32-byte x coordinate.

name: HASH160 commitment
formal_definition: RIPEMD160(SHA256(compressed public key)) yields the 20-byte P2WPKH witness program.

name: P2WPKH script relation
formal_definition: Witness v0 with a 20-byte key hash maps to scriptPubKey 0x0014{program}.

name: Eight-to-five-bit regrouping
formal_definition: Convert witness-program bytes into 5-bit Bech32 data groups with canonical padding.

name: Human-readable prefix
formal_definition: Bind the network namespace through HRP such as bc or tb.

name: Bech32 checksum shell
formal_definition: Witness version 0 addresses use the BIP173 polymod constant.

name: Bech32m checksum shell
formal_definition: Witness versions 1-16 use the BIP350 polymod constant.

name: Public address decoder
formal_definition: Validate case, HRP, checksum family, witness version, program length and script projection.

name: Witness-program classifier
formal_definition: Classify v0/20 as P2WPKH, v0/32 as P2WSH and v1/32 as a Taproot-compatible form.

name: Non-reversibility boundary
formal_definition: Address decoding exposes a script commitment, not a private key, seed or spend authority.

name: User-supplied public address fixture
formal_definition: Use the supplied bc1q address only for format, checksum, witness-program and scriptPubKey validation.

name: Self-owned known-seed audit
formal_definition: Permit deterministic backup verification only when the operator already possesses the mnemonic or seed.

name: Watch-only public audit
formal_definition: Permit address/descriptor parsing and public derivation evidence without spend authority.

name: Authorization gate
formal_definition: Every audit declares a scope and is rejected if any operation targets private keys, third-party secrets or funds.

name: Forbidden-target rejection
formal_definition: Reject mnemonic enumeration, passphrase spraying, private-key scanning and address-targeted preimage search.

name: No-network reference runtime
formal_definition: The reference implementation performs no blockchain queries, balance lookups or remote calls.

name: No-signing reference runtime
formal_definition: The reference implementation exposes no transaction signing, PSBT mutation, broadcast or funds-transfer path.

name: Uniform search-space estimator
formal_definition: Report 2^b candidates, 2^(b-1) expected guesses and time at a declared optimistic rate; do not enumerate.

name: Valid mnemonic keyspace
formal_definition: A 12-word BIP39 space contains 2^128 valid mnemonics; checksum filtering does not reduce the encoded entropy below ENT.

name: Reduced synthetic metric
formal_definition: Use a 20-bit toy space only to explain scale; it is explicitly not a Bitcoin wallet or key search.

name: Public-only derivation certificate
formal_definition: Return path, parent routing fingerprint, compressed public key, HASH160, script and address while excluding mnemonic-, seed- and private-key-derived commitments.

name: Audit lineage record
formal_definition: Log standards profile, public fixture digest, reason codes and test-vector result, never mnemonic/seed/private keys.

name: Canonical UGTS handoff
formal_definition: After cryptographic certification, return to support, compatibility, guard, event, transition and lineage.
